execution_model.position_size: equity*risk_per_trade / planned Entry-SL distance, floored to live step size
execution_model.margin: live current defaultLeverage; sum initial margins cannot exceed realized equity
execution_model.fees: current live contract defaultTakerFeeRate for entry and every exit fill
execution_model.slippage: adverse percentage on entry and every exit fill
execution_model.funding: historical settled funding; position value uses settlement oracle price
execution_model.funding_split_caveat: full original size assumed through final exit; conservative for adverse funding after TP1
execution_model.stock_closed_approx: optional stress test rejects stock entries on weekends and four US full-day holidays in sample; not a complete exchange calendar
